overall_summary: Data volume is low, leading to low statistical confidence. However, a clear outlier pattern emerges around marital and relationship dynamics (Husband-Wife topics), which significantly outperform general family shayari or standalone sad poetry.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,766 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,672 views) received nearly 10x the views of other topics.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on marriage, couple friction, and emotional drift over time as the primary repeatable topic.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 13 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid heavy, abstract, or overly poetic sad shayari; ground the emotion in concrete everyday relationship observations.

experiment: Testing if micro-habits in long-term relationships (texting vs talking) drive higher engagement than direct emotional questions.
